title: Siege of Danzig (1734)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Danzig (1734)", at revision 1370740617, opens: "The siege of Danzig of 1734 was the Russian encirclement and capture of the Polish city-port of Gdańsk, during the War of Polish Succession. It was the first time that troops of France and Russia had met as foes in the field." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2354105, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1734 siege during War of the Polish Succession". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
